newsitem.title: USA: Ariad buys patent rights from Mitotix.
newsitem.headline: Ariad buys patent rights from Mitotix.

text.p: ARIAD Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday it acquired a portfolio of pending patent applications and related intellectual property rights to an protein called FRAP from Mitotix Inc.
ARIAD said it will pay Mitotix, a privately-held company, an undisclosed amount for the FRAP patent portfolio, and has granted back to Mitotix a license for diagnostic applications.
The transaction does not involve royalties or milestone payments.
FRAP is the biological target of an orally administered drug called rapamycin.
Ariad said it is using the rapamycin-dependent interaction between FRAP and another molecule called FKBP for regulating gene expression using orally administered drugs.
Ariad said it is developing this system as a means of controlling the dose of therapeutic proteins delivered by gene therapy.
This system is being designed to provide more convenient and potentially more effective protein therapy than current methods, which require frequent injections.
